name: devfolio
description: Devfolio: a modern developer-portfolio theme for HubSpot CMS, built with CMS React + HubL

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add src/theme/devfolio-theme/theme.json src/theme/devfolio-theme/package.json src/theme/devfolio-theme/components/shared/version.ts CHANGELOG.md
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run deploy
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run deploy
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore(release): v%s" && npm run deploy
